findings.claim: eBay 10-K 揭露 2023–2025 各年度皆無單一客戶占淨營收超過 10%。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025（申報 2026-02-19）財報附註 Concentration of credit risk
findings.excerpt: In each of the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, no customer accounted for more than 10% of net revenues.

findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 7 MD&A Net Revenues by Geography
